trace.question: Write the full names of students who received funds on the date of 9/9/2019 and include the amount received.
trace.evidence: full name refers to first_name, last_name, amount of funds received refers to amount, received funds on date refers to date_received

attempts.sql:
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, i.amount
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, i.amount
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'
trace.answer: Sacha Harrison received 50 and Carlo Jacobs received 50 on 9/9/2019.
